reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis correctly cites the well-known interplay of entropic stabilization and local enthalpic clustering in high-entropy alloys at elevated temperatures, aligning with established theories and experimental observations.
reasons.testability: A clearly defined comparison between rapid quenching and high-temperature annealing, combined with direct structural and compositional characterization (e.g., by APT, HRTEM) and property measurements, provides a straightforward, decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the fundamental balance of entropy and enthalpy in high-entropy systems, providing a targeted experimental plan and meaningful metrics, which would significantly guide research on alloy stability.
